business.name: St Aldhelm's Church
business.description: A friendly parish church in Westbrook. Sunday services, toddler group, food bank collection and community events.

seo.title: St Aldhelm's Church, Westbrook | Everyone welcome
seo.description: Join us on Sundays at 10:30am at St Aldhelm's Church, Westbrook. Service times, groups, events and how to get in touch.

sections.heading: Whoever you are, you are welcome here.
sections.text: St Aldhelm's is a friendly parish church at the centre of Westbrook. Come as you are, stay for coffee.

items.title: Sunday service · 10:30am
items.text: Family-friendly worship with a children's group during the talk. Refreshments afterwards.

items.title: Little Lambs · Tuesday 9:30am
items.text: Stay and play for under fives and their grown-ups. Term time only, no need to book.

items.title: Community lunch · Thursday 12pm
items.text: A hot meal and good company in the church hall. Pay what you can.

sections.heading: New here?
body: Walking into a church for the first time can feel daunting. You will be met at the door, shown where to sit and never asked to do anything you are not comfortable with.
Services last about an hour. There is level access throughout, a hearing loop and plenty of parking on Church Lane.

sections.heading: Weddings, christenings and funerals
sections.text: We would be honoured to walk with you through life's big moments. Get in touch with the church office to talk it through.

pages.title: What's on
pages.description: Service times, groups and regular events at St Aldhelm's Church, Westbrook.

sections.heading: What's on
sections.text: Everything is free unless it says otherwise, and everyone is welcome.

sections.heading: Visit and contact
sections.text: The church office is open Tuesday to Thursday, 9:30am to 12:30pm.
